items.difficulty_reason: The exact free-variable calculus under substitution when the variable actually occurs (statement 1267-1270, proof 1272-1299). The load-bearing abstraction case is a complete five-line computation; the base variable case is trivial and the application case states both of its ingredients before leaving the routine set-union bookkeeping as an exercise. H2: one full induction case plus two elementary ones.
